basic_details.job_title: IIT Delhi Senior Project Scientist Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (IIT Delhi) has released the recruitment notification for 1 vacancy for the Sr. Project Scientist post on a project-based engagement. The tenure is upto 25 May 2027 or renewable yearly or upto duration of the project, whichever is earlier, with a pay of Rs. 60,750 - Rs. 79,260 per month. plus HRA @27%. Candidates applying for the Sr. Project Scientist post must possess a 1st class M.Tech or equivalent degree in Atmospheric Sciences or Energy Science. age_limit.details: A 5% relaxation of marks may be granted to the SC/ST Candidates.

qualification.details: Knowledge on numerical weather forecasting (WRF), large climate data analysis, and proficiency in software tools such as Python and MATLAB.

how_to_apply: Download Form No. IRD/REC-4 from the IRD Website (http://ird.iitd.ac.in/rec).
Fill out the downloaded Form No. IRD/REC-4 completely with details of work experience, percentage of marks, and division.
Attach required supporting documents regarding educational qualifications and experience.
Send the completed application by email to Prof. K. Ravi Kumar at email id: [email protected].
Ensure the advertisement number IITD/IRD/290/2026 is mentioned on the subject line of the email.
Submit the application via email on or before 30/10/2026 by 5.00 p.m.

content_sections.heading: IIT Delhi Sr. Project Scientist at a Glance

rows.details: Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (IIT Delhi)
Dept. of Energy Science and Engineering
Study of the Long-term Trends and Co-variability in Wind, Solar and Precipitation Resources in different states of India and the Relationship between them. (RP04589N)
Upto 25/05/2027 (renewable yearly or upto duration of the project, whichever is earlier)

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The recruitment notification announces a total of 1 vacancy for the Sr. Project Scientist position under the specified project in the Department of Energy Science and Engineering.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for the position must meet the essential educational qualifications required for the project appointment. Knowledge on numerical weather forecasting (WRF), large climate data analysis, and proficiency in software tools such as Python and MATLAB. A 5% relaxation of marks may be granted to the SC/ST Candidates.

rows.essential_qualification_required: 1st class M.Tech or equivalent degree in Atmospheric Sciences or Energy Science.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated fellowship and pay slabs range from Rs. 60,750 to Rs. 79,260 per month plus HRA @27%, distributed across pay slabs: Rs. 60,750 - 62,570, Rs. 64,450 - 66,380 - 68,370, Rs. 70,420 - 72,530 - 74,710, and Rs. 76,950 - 79,260. The appointment is on a contractual basis with consolidated pay, renewable yearly or upto the duration of the project, whichever is earlier. In case of selection of a retired/superannuated government employee, his/her salary will be fixed as per prevailing IRD norms.

content_sections.heading: IIT Delhi Sr. Project Scientist Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will work on the research project titled "Study of the Long-term Trends and Co-variability in Wind, Solar and Precipitation Resources in different states of India and the Relationship between them" (RP04589N) funded by Renew Power, focusing on large climate data analysis, numerical weather forecasting, and wind, solar, and precipitation resource trends.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: IIT Delhi reserves the right to fix higher criteria for short-listing of eligible candidates from those satisfying advertised qualification and requirement of the project. Only short-listed candidates will be informed for online interview with the online interview details displayed on the web link (http://iitd.iitd.ac.in/shortlisted).

rows.details: Download application form from IRD website
